services.name: Airport of Entry
services.description:
An authorized airport of entry for clearance of all classes of scheduled and unscheduled aircraft (travellers and cargo).

AOE/#: An airport of entry for the clearance of scheduled and unscheduled air traffic but with traveller restrictions as indicated by an appropriate numerical designator (e.g. AOE/125).

services.name: Cruise Ship Operations
services.description: An authorized disembarkation site for travellers and crew of all types of cruise ships.

services.name: Commercial Vessel
services.description: An authorized marine port of entry where cargo and commercial vessels, other than ferry boats or cruise ships, but including other commercial passenger vessels such as tour boats and charter boats (e.g., whale-watching, fishing, sightseeing), report to the CBSA.

services.name: Electronic Data Interchange
services.description: A CBSA office that provides for the electronic transmission and interchange of cargo, release, and accounting data.

services.name: Ferry Terminal
services.description: An authorized point of entry for the disembarkation of travellers and/or vehicles arriving by ferry.

services.name: Highway/Land Border Office
services.description: A CBSA highway port of entry for the processing of travellers, crew and/or for the reporting and clearing of commercial goods.

services.name: Inland Alternate Service
services.description: A location that is not staffed by the CBSA for which a designated Central Office provides commercial and traveller services.

services.name: Non-Terminal Office
services.description: The CBSA does not accept electronic release or accounting data for commercial transactions at these offices.

services.name: CBSA Mail Centre
services.description: A CBSA office for the processing and examination of international mail. No public access.

services.name: Railway Depot
services.description: An authorized point of entry for the reporting of travellers and/or freight arriving by rail.

services.name: Duty-Free Shop
services.description: A location at which a duty free shop is located within close proximity to the CBSA port of entry.

services.name: HUB/Central Office
services.description: A CBSA office responsible for providing service to Inland Alternate Service (IAS) sites and other service locations reporting to the Central Office.

services.name: Designated Commercial Office
services.description: A designated port of entry which provides 24 hour service - 7 days a week, for the reporting and clearing of commercial goods.

services.name: Casual Refund Centre
services.description: An office for the processing of non-commercial refund claims for duties and taxes on postal/courier and travellers importations.

services.name: Airport of Entry/CANPASS
services.description: An airport of entry designated for CANPASS private and corporate permit holders only. CANPASS members can land at an AOE any time the airport is open for landing, regardless of the hours of business of the local CBSA office.

services.name: Inland Office
services.description: A CBSA office classified as a non-direct point of entry providing a full range of CBSA services to the general public and to other service sites, e.g. In-bond highway, marine, rail, etc.

services.name: NEXUS/Highway
services.description: An authorized point of entry for members of the joint Canada/U.S. NEXUS Highway Program only.

services.name: Free and Secure Trade
services.description: A land border port of entry at which Free and Secure Trade (FAST) program members can receive expedited clearance for commercial cargo.

services.name: Free and Secure Trade/Driver Enrollment Centers
services.description: Offices having a driver enrollment centre for the Free and Secure Trade (FAST) program located on the premises.

services.name: Airport of Entry/Military
services.description: An airport of entry for clearance of military aircraft only, unless otherwise designated (e.g. AOE/15).

services.name: Telephone Reporting Site/Marine
services.description: A marine port of entry at which private pleasure craft operators must report by telephone, unless directed otherwise by an officer.

services.name: Airport of Entry/Cargo
services.description: An airport of entry solely for the reporting and processing of commercial cargo and crew arriving by air transport.

services.name: Airport of Entry/15/Seaplane
services.description: A water aerodrome airport of entry solely for the clearance of persons arriving by seaplane where the flights are unscheduled and the traveller capacity does not exceed 15 people (including the crew). Operators of these flights must obtain CBSA approval by contacting the CBSA’s Telephone Reporting Center to enter or return to Canada, and they must land at an approved AOE during CBSA hours of business.

services.name: Airport of Entry/CANPASS/Seaplane
services.description:
A water aerodrome designated for CANPASS private and corporate permit holders.

A water aerodrome airport of entry designated only for CANPASS private and corporate permit holders to a maximum of 15 people (including crew). CANPASS members can land at an AOE any time the airport is open for landing, regardless of the hours of business of the local CBSA office.

services.name: Direct Reporting Site for Marine Private Vessel
services.description: A CBSA staffed marine port of entry where private pleasure craft MUST report directly.

services.name: Designated Export Reporting Office
services.description: A designated office for the reporting and processing of export declarations and permits.

services.name: NEXUS/Marine
services.description: An authorized point of entry for members of the joint Canada/U.S. NEXUS Marine Program only.

services.name: Courier Low Value Shipments Program
services.description: A CBSA office where Courier Low Value Shipments (CLVS) Program clearances are performed.

services.name: NEXUS/Air
services.description: An authorized point of entry for members of the joint Canada/U.S. NEXUS Air Program only.

services.name: Airport of Entry/15
services.description: An airport used solely for clearing persons arriving by general aviation aircraft (private or company) where the flights are unscheduled and the number of non-paying travellers on each flight does not exceed 15 (including the crew). Operators of these flights must obtain CBSA approval by contacting the CBSA's Telephone Reporting Center to enter or return to Canada, and they must land at an approved AOE during CBSA hours of business.

services.name: Electronic Longroom - Export
services.description: Designated office that offers email service for the submission of export permits, licences, certificates and other acceptable documents.

services.name: Electronic Longroom - Manifest
services.description: Commercial office that offers email service for certain paper cargo requests and corrections.

services.name: Electronic Longroom - Release
services.description: Commercial office that offers email service for certain paper release requests and corrections.

services.name: Electronic Longroom - Vessel
services.description: Designated office that offers email service for the submission of eligible vessel clearance documents.

services.name: Trade Operations
services.description: Offices with Senior Officers Trade Compliance (SOTC) that conduct compliance verifications and provide trade services including rulings, B2 adjustments, drawbacks and duties relief. No public access is available.

services.name: Pilot Project for Travellers in Remote Areas/Quebec
services.description: An authorized land port of entry solely for members of the Pilot Project for Travellers in Remote Areas - Quebec permit holders.

services.name: Telephone Reporting Site/Land
services.description: An authorized port of entry for persons arriving in Canada aboard a non-commercial passenger conveyance other than a marine vessel, aircraft or train at which persons onboard must report by telephone, unless directed otherwise by an officer.

services.name: US Preclearance/Air
services.description: A designated preclearance area at an airport where travellers and goods can be precleared to enter the United States by a US Customs and Border Protection preclearance officer working at a preclearance operation in Canada.

services.name: US Preclearance/Marine
services.description: A designated preclearance area at a ferry or cruise ship terminal where travellers and goods can be precleared to enter the United States by a US Customs and Border Protection preclearance officer working at a preclearance operation in Canada.

services.name: US Preclearance/Land
services.description: A designated preclearance area at a land border crossing where travellers and goods can be precleared to enter the United States by a US Customs and Border Protection preclearance officer working at a preclearance operation in Canada.

services.name: US Preclearance/Rail
services.description: A designated preclearance area at a passenger rail station where travellers and goods can be precleared to enter the United States by a US Customs and Border Protection preclearance officer working at a preclearance operation in Canada.

services.name: CBSA Preclearance/Land
services.description: A designated preclearance area where travellers and goods can be precleared to enter Canada by a Canadian border services officer working at a preclearance operation in the United States.

services.name: Airport of Entry / Seasonal
services.description: An authorized airport of entry for clearance of all classes of scheduled and unscheduled aircraft (travellers and cargo). This airport of entry may also have another designated level of service. AOE / # / Seasonal: Airport of entry for the clearance of scheduled air traffic but with traveller restrictions as indicated by an appropriate numerical designator (e.g. AOE/125) and by a seasonal timeframe.
